name: How long does drain backup repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does drain backup repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of drain backup repair can range from less than an hour for minor clogs to several hours or even a full day for more complex issues. Simple blockages cleared with standard tools are usually resolved quickly. Repairs involving video inspection, hydro-jetting, or addressing main line problems, especially those caused by tree roots or damaged pipes, naturally take longer due to the diagnostic and intensive clearing processes involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from under an hour for minor clogs to several hours or a full day for complex issues like main line problems.
